resources.string: Sends today\'s and tomorrow\'s meetings from this phone\'s calendar to the CalenTime watch face. Private events go without their title or place. Your calendar is sent only to your watch.
Calendar access is off, so there\'s nothing to send to the watch.
No events found from yesterday to tomorrow. Apps like Outlook keep their calendar separate: in Outlook, open Settings, tap your account and turn on Sync calendars. Then tap Sync now.
No watch connected. Open Galaxy Wearable or Wear OS on this phone and check the watch is paired.
Send your calendar to your watch with one tap.
